reporting-org.narrative: Digital Impact Alliance at Capital For Good

description.narrative:
This program translates learning into action. Drawing from DIAL’s country and global engagements — and informed by targeted research and consultative learning — the team develops practical guidance, frameworks, and tools that help decision makers navigate the complexity of building inclusive and trusted data ecosystems.
By turning real-world experience into usable resources, the team equips policymakers, funders, and practitioners with the knowledge needed to make thoughtful design choices, understand trade-offs, and implement good practices.
The team also ensures coherence and quality across DIAL’s body of work, reinforcing the integration of rules, tools, institutions, and practices throughout our efforts.
